Downtown Peoria.name: Downtown Peoria
Downtown Peoria.description: Riverfront core around the Warehouse District with mixed-use conversion and medical-campus spillover.

North Peoria.name: North Peoria
North Peoria.description: Northern growth corridor along Knoxville and Sheridan with retail centres and newer subdivisions.

West Bluff.name: West Bluff
West Bluff.description: Historic bluff neighbourhoods west of downtown anchored by Bradley University and steady rehab activity.

Peoria Heights.name: Peoria Heights
Peoria Heights.description: Village district above the river bluff with boutique retail along Prospect Road and infill housing.

East Peoria.name: East Peoria
East Peoria.description: East-bank commercial strip along IL-8 and the Levee District with riverfront redevelopment.

Morton.name: Morton
Morton.description: Suburban Tazewell village with distribution employment and consistent single-family construction.

Pekin.name: Pekin
Pekin.description: Tazewell County seat south of the metro with industrial riverfront and established residential stock.
